blurb: A centrally concentrated γ = 4/3 star grazes a million-solar-mass black hole (β = 1): it loses its outer layers and survives. In the star’s rest frame.

featured.label: Perturber : star mass
featured.tip: Mass of the black hole over the star’s. Sets the orbit: changing it starts the run again

featured.label: Impact parameter β
featured.tip: Tidal radius over pericenter distance: above 1 the star passes inside the tidal radius. Changing it starts the run again
